subject: general
question:
Four different positions of the same dice are shown. Select the symbol that will be on the face opposite to the one having +.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/144b0eafc5184e7fec336067f0cfc665189660d763eafea5f1d3a475d356cf71.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given four different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As + is common on both the dices I and IV, it is clear that —, #, &, and * are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. $ will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe88198eaea3081a638123cf9e45ffd10dafb5deac490da84ee1e89d36f8aedf.png] 

Opposite pairs:

— → *

# → &

+ → $

So, the opposite side of "+" will be side "$".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
